title: Sheet-metal MCP tools
summary: AI agents can now create sheet-metal parts, unfold them to a layered DXF, and check manufacturability against a shop profile — closing the create→check→fix loop.
details:
## What's New

- **`sheet_metal_create`** — build a rectangular base flange plus an ordered chain of edge flanges; returns a session `document_id` (reusable with inspect_cad / export_cad / open_in_browser), the panel/bend model, flat bbox + area, and generic-shop DFM.
- **`sheet_metal_unfold`** — flat pattern (outlines, holes, creases, area, bbox) plus the layered DXF (CUT / BEND_UP / BEND_DOWN, mm).
- **`sheet_metal_check`** — manufacturability vs. a field-tolerant shop profile; structured violations an agent can act on, then re-check.

This is the AI-native leg of the sheet-metal bet: an LLM can iterate to a manufacturable part without a human in the loop. `cost` and `suggest_fix` are deferred until the process-cost model and IR-edit primitives land.
